title: WireGuard (wg-easy)
description: WireGuard VPN with a web UI for handing out client configurations.

fields.name: host
fields.label: Public hostname or IP
fields.help: What clients dial. It must resolve from outside this network.

fields.name: password_hash
fields.label: UI password hash
fields.help: A bcrypt hash, not the password itself — wg-easy takes PASSWORD_HASH. Generate it with the project's own instructions.

fields.name: ui_port
fields.label: Web UI port
fields.help: Keep this off the public internet; it hands out VPN configurations.

fields.name: data_volume
fields.label: Config volume
fields.help: Holds the server key and every client's configuration.

notes: This needs NET_ADMIN and SYS_MODULE plus two sysctls, so it takes the privileged permission. Clients dial {{host}}:{{vpn_port}} over UDP; the UI is on {{ui_port}}.
